tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250'jam dpal nag po thugs kyi yang zhun gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun bzang 'jam dpal pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// mnga' bdag yab sras ye shes mtsho rgyal ma// zab gter mnga' bdag o rgyan sangs rgyas gling*// rang sras bdun rgyud

ye shes rdo rje/ sangs rgyas blo gros/ bsod nams lhun grub/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ karma bzang po/ karma sngags 'chang*/ rig 'dzin snying po'i bar bde chen dar rgyas dang*/ bka' drin mtshungs med bde chen rab gsal zhabs// rtsa ba'i bla ma dran chog 'khor lo'i mgon// 'jam dpal yang zhun smin grol brgyud pa yi// bla ma rnams dang yi dam lhag pa'i lhar// rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthu stobs kyis// las bzhi lhun grub grub pa che brgyad thob/ khyad par tshe dbang phyag rgya che mchog grub// 'jam dpal go 'phang tshe 'dir thob byin rlobs// zhes 'jam dpal nag po thugs kyi yang zhun gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di yang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus sbyar ba'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
